restrictions: The target is complete-message SHA-256 with the fixed FIPS 180-4 IV, standard padding, feed-forward, original compression steps 0 through 31 on every padded block, and equality of all 256 output bits.

The certificate contains two distinct 128-byte messages. The organizer-owned target checker recomputes their common digest f8a3db111360e5ed2e63041ecfa82b01c95a25882910bc0f21671949296a4e77 under sha256-r32-prefix-v1.

The certificate and retained constructor source derive from yudduy public unpromoted submission 8f95560 (commit 689cb95ecd1538f08b536741a696c74f6fb78ea5). The scored fixed-prefix constructor uses the same pinned source and deterministic seeds but stops after chunk 34, where the retained terminal audit and complete-message certificate prove success.

The winner is bound to chunk 34, seed 202610040034, counter 2149248237, local tuple index 15529, global admitted tuple index 14240177 below 2^30, and tail index 131794 below 196608. The complete tuple file has SHA-256 c3ea41e428beae328693cef62f32beb8f7753f2a7def98280ecd5cf847ba86ad.

The corrected terminal audit 181b7fe2ba0ce6cfa0bc2733dc6e3f18f385524f1e9100ec7fd05604adf74097 reports a quiescent run with no errors or warnings and binds 35 completed matcher attempts, 35 completed Step-3 attempts, and one independently verified collision.

The online envelope is N <= 35*2^36*(1+9724608/2224) + 14643237*196608*(2+2^16/2224) + 2^45, with log2(N)=53.241028551157605. It charges every failed chunk and every reserved tuple in the successful 35-attempt prefix, while tightening the source-derived matcher slot allowance from 2^24 to 9724608.

The preprocessing bound is the exploratory premise P < 2^63 + 2^51, with log2(P)=63.0003521774803. The paper reports 2^48.335 total work for a harder 35-step attack; rounding to 2^49 and multiplying by full C=2224 still leaves a factor 1024/139 above 7 under 2^63. The receipted local work is below 2^51. This is not a historical instruction trace; unrecorded route or development work above this envelope invalidates the claim.

The combined bound is log2(P+N) < 63.00201587724125 < 63.01 target-compression units. The 35-attempt stop is a public fixed cap in this finite deterministic construction, supported by the retained terminal lineage; it does not predict fresh-search success in 35 attempts.

Memory below 2^48 simultaneously live bytes is an exploratory constructive phase and machine-capacity envelope. Current phases are below 2^34 bytes, the campaign host has below 2^36 physical bytes, and the paper reports a below-2^39 server capacity; no historical peak-RSS trace is claimed.

The post-terminal inventory binds 5,760,270,500 unique retained bytes plus a 234,801-byte inventory and a full 2^26-byte downstream envelope, totaling 5,827,614,165 bytes below 2^33. Material nonuniform files outside the four scanned roots would invalidate the advice bound.

success_probability 1 describes coinless replay of this fixed, mechanically checked witness after all discovery work is charged. The organizer experiment derives and repeats the committed pair; it is not a fresh-search forecast, resource measurement, or empirical campaign success rate.

The construction instantiates the two-block framework of Yingxin Li, Fukang Liu, Gaoli Wang, and Jiali Shi (IACR ePrint 2026/1080). The implementation, exact r32 witness, bounded campaign, and HashSmash accounting are project-specific; no broader round or full-SHA-256 claim is made.
The hit occurred at chunk 34, before review checkpoints 640 and 1292, so no checkpoint approval or consumed-token artifact is part of the winner lineage.

heuristics.statement: All non-preprocessing work of the finite 35-attempt deterministic constructor is below 2^53.25 collision-frontier-v5 target-compression units.
heuristics.scope: The pinned matcher and 35 successful-prefix chunks, 14,643,237 charged tuple records, tail search, final verification, recovery, hashing, inventory administration, and all failures before the documented hit.
heuristics.extrapolation: The source path bound gives at most 9724608 primitives per matcher slot, hence N <= 35*2^36*(1+9724608/2224) + 14643237*196608*(2+2^16/2224) + 2^45, with log2(N)=53.241028551157605.
heuristics.limitations: This finite cap depends on the documented constructor reproducing the terminal 35-attempt hit. An omitted path, different table/source, or incorrect per-item allowance invalidates it. The cap is not a fresh-search performance forecast.
